camel_example: aliyun emas-appmonitor GetTlogCollectList --region cn-hangzhou --Os android --PageSize 30 --AppKey 24780725 --PageIndex 1 --version 2019-06-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Retrieves a list of device log tasks
description_zh: 获取设备日志任务列表数据
name: GetTlogCollectList

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type. Valid values:
iphoneos: Apple
android: Android
parameters.help_zh:
os类型
iphoneos(苹果)
android(安卓)
parameters.name: os

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The collection status. If this parameter is left empty, tasks in all statuses are queried. Valid values:
START: The task is created and waiting to be pulled by the device.
PULL_REPLIED: The device has pulled the task.
FILE_SENDED: The log file information has been sent to the parsing pipeline.
FINISHED: The log is pulled.
FAIL_OVER: The log pull failed.
SUSPENDED: The log pull timed out.
CANCELLED: The task is canceled
parameters.help_zh:
采集状态，为空查询全状态
START  任务已创建，等待设备拉取
PULL_REPLIED 设备已拉取到任务
FILE_SENDED 日志文件信息已发送给解析链路
FINISHED 日志拉取成功
FAIL_OVER 日志拉取失败
SUSPENDED 日志拉取超时
CANCELLED 任务已取消
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword for general exact match. The system uses this value to query by device ID or user nickname simultaneously
parameters.help_zh: 通用精确查询；代码会同时作为 deviceId/userNick查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The device task type. Valid values:
USER: pull by user ID
AUTO: batch pull
AUTO_RT: conditional pull
POSITIVE: proactive reporting
parameters.help_zh:
设备任务类型
USER ID 拉取
AUTO 批量拉取
AUTO_RT 条件拉取
_ POSITIVE 主动上报
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The start time when the device log task was created. This parameter is used to query device log retrieval tasks
parameters.help_zh: 设备日志任务创建开始时间，用于查询回捞设备任务
parameters.name: create_begin_date

parameters.help_en: The end time when the device log task was created. This parameter is used to query device log retrieval tasks
parameters.help_zh: 设备日志任务创建结束时间，用于查询回捞设备任务
parameters.name: create_end_date

parameters.help_en: The start time when the device log task was updated. This parameter is used to query proactively reported device tasks
parameters.help_zh: 设备日志任务更新开始时间，用于查询主动上报设备任务
parameters.name: update_begin_date

parameters.help_en: The end time when the device log task was updated. This parameter is used to query proactively reported device tasks
parameters.help_zh: 设备日志任务更新结束时间，用于查询主动上报设备任务
parameters.name: update_end_date

parameters.help_en: The remark for proactive reporting. This parameter is used to query proactively reported device tasks
parameters.help_zh: 主动上报备注，用于查询主动上报设备任务
parameters.name: positive_comment

Items.description_en: The list of device log tasks

items.description_en:
The fields are described as follows:

id: The record ID. For non-proactive reporting, it is usually the same as the task ID. For proactive reporting, it is the collection record ID.
taskId: The task ID. For non-proactive reporting, it is usually the same as the id. For proactive reporting, it is the system-generated collection task ID.
taskName: The task name. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
appId: The application dimension ID, in the format of `<appKey>@<os>`.
appKey: The AppKey of the application.
sourceType: The log source type. USER indicates a retrieval task created in the console, and POSITIVE indicates proactive reporting from the client.
taskType: The task type. Fixed as REMOTE_LOG for remote logs.
status: The current status. Common values include NORMAL for task dimensions and FINISHED after proactive reporting is completed.
reason: The reason object. For non-proactive reporting, it usually contains type and description. For proactive reporting, it may only contain extraInfo.
mode: The task mode. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
templateConfig: The JSON string of the task template configuration, including configurations such as the number of log retrieval days and the deadline.
notifySetting: The notification configuration object. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
author: The initiator. For non-proactive reporting, it is the console user. For proactive reporting, it is usually the device user nickname.
authorEmpId: The employee or account ID of the initiator. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
authorParentEmpId: The main account or parent account ID of the initiator. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
collectionNums: The total number of devices for task collection. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
successNums: The number of successful collections. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
failNums: The number of failed collections. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
fileNums: The number of files. Returned for non-proactive reporting tasks.
progress: The task progress, formatted as an internal system statistics string.
dayNum: The number of retrieval days or valid collection days.
createTime: The creation time, in UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
modifyTime: The modification time, in UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
firstTime: The response time of the first device, in UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The value is 0 if no response is received.
succeededTime: The completion time, in UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The value is 0 if the task is not completed.
deviceId: The device ID. Returned for proactive reporting records.
userName: The user nickname. Returned for proactive reporting records.
sessionId: The session ID. Returned for proactive reporting records, which may be empty.
requestId: The proactive reporting request ID.
positiveComment: The proactive reporting remark.
expireTime: The expiration time of the collection record, in UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
fileSize: The number of uploaded files or the file size field. In the current proactive reporting scenario, it usually indicates the number of files.
appVersion: The app version. Returned for proactive reporting records.
os: The device operating system name, which may be the original value from the client.
osVersion: The operating system version.
brand: The device brand.
deviceModel: The device model.
geo: The geographical information
items.description_zh:
按你给的字段内容转换如下：

id String 记录 ID，非主动上报时通常等同任务 ID，主动上报时为采集记录 ID
taskId String 任务 ID，非主动上报时通常与 id 相同，主动上报时为系统生成的采集任务 ID
taskName String 任务名称，非主动上报任务返回
appId String 应用维度 ID，格式为 `<appKey>@<os>`
appKey String 应用 AppKey
sourceType String 日志来源类型，USER 表示控制台创建的回捞任务，POSITIVE 表示端上主动上报
taskType String 任务类型，远程日志固定为 REMOTE_LOG
status String 当前状态，任务维度常见 NORMAL，主动上报完成后常见 FINISHED
reason Object 发起原因对象，非主动上报通常包含 type、description，主动上报可能仅包含 extraInfo
mode String 任务模式，非主动上报任务返回
templateConfig String 任务模板配置 JSON 字符串，包含日志回捞天数、截止时间等配置
notifySetting Object 通知配置对象，非主动上报任务返回
author String 发起人，非主动上报为控制台用户，主动上报通常为设备用户昵称
authorEmpId String 发起人员工或账号 ID，非主动上报任务返回
authorParentEmpId String 发起人主账号或上级账号 ID，非主动上报任务返回
collectionNums Long 任务采集设备总数，非主动上报任务返回
successNums Long 成功采集数量，非主动上报任务返回
failNums Long 失败采集数量，非主动上报任务返回
fileNums Long 文件数量，非主动上报任务返回
progress String 任务进度，格式为系统内部统计串
dayNum Integer 回捞天数或采集有效天数
createTime Long 创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
modifyTime Long 修改时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
firstTime Long 首台设备响应时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳，未发生时为 0
succeededTime Long 成功完成时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳，未完成时为 0
deviceId String 设备 ID，主动上报记录返回
userName String 用户昵称，主动上报记录返回
sessionId String 会话 ID，主动上报记录返回，可能为空
requestId String 主动上报请求 ID
positiveComment String 主动上报备注
expireTime Long 采集记录过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
fileSize Long 已上传文件数量或文件大小字段，当前主动上报场景常表示文件数
appVersion String App 版本，主动上报记录返回
os String 设备系统名称，可能为端上原始值
osVersion String 系统版本
brand String 设备品牌
deviceModel String 设备机型
geo String 地域信息
